theme: CI/release artifact inventory PATHGLOB full paths + STEM/EXT FREQ

tests.name: pglob_bin
tests.cmd: PATHGLOB out *.bin → 1 full path app.bin (not nested)

tests.name: shellpat_so
tests.cmd: one-arg PATHGLOB dir/*.so → lib.so full path

tests.name: pglob_star_dirs
tests.cmd: PATHGLOB out * → 6 entries incl nested/ dir

tests.name: measure_fullpath
tests.cmd: SIZE each full path → basename:bytes; nested dir SIZE 0
tests.note: no JOIN glue; dir pollutes bag

tests.name: has_exact_path
tests.cmd: HASLINE exact full path hit; dir prefix miss soft

tests.name: pglob_empty_match
tests.cmd: empty dir *.bin OK soft; REQUIRE exit 2

weaknesses.title: PATHGLOB includes directories; no files-only mode
weaknesses.detail: PATHGLOB dir * returns subdirs (nested/) alongside files. SIZE on dir is OK=1 LAST_N=0, so measure invents nested:0 junk keys. Agents need ISDIR/ISFILE filter loop.

weaknesses.title: PATHGLOB non-recursive; nested artifacts invisible
weaknesses.detail: out/nested/deep.bin not matched by *.bin at out/. Pattern is basename-level in one directory only. Same class as GLOB. No ** support.
weaknesses.repro: PATHGLOB out *.bin → app.bin only; deep.bin missed

weaknesses.title: EXTNAME last suffix only (.tar.gz → .gz)
weaknesses.detail: STEM of data.tar.gz is data.tar not data. Double-extension archives mis-typed in FREQ rollups. No multi-suffix peel.

weaknesses.title: SIZE on directory succeeds with 0 bytes
weaknesses.detail: ISDIR true but SIZE returns OK=1 LAST_N=0 instead of soft miss. Silent pollution of size bags when PATHGLOB mixes dirs.

weaknesses.title: PATHGLOB empty match OK=1 vs missing dir OK=0
weaknesses.detail: Same as GLOB: no files matching is success-empty; bad directory fails. Agents checking only OK miss empty inventories.

weaknesses.title: KEEPKEY substring on basename keys
weaknesses.detail: Needle bin matches app.bin. Exact key needs LOOKUP/EQS after peel.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: Full path bags collapse to one JSON string without \n separators visible as array. Agents cannot re-split from PRINT_JSON alone.

workarounds: After PATHGLOB filter with ISDIR/ISFILE before SIZE
Prefer extension patterns (*.bin) over * to avoid dirs when possible
Treat PATHGLOB_N==0 as soft empty even when OK=1
For archives, peel known multi-suffixes with STRIPSUFFIX before STEM
Use full-path HASLINE for membership; never prefix-match
PATHGLOB then READ/SIZE/RM without JOIN — main win vs GLOB
language_gaps: SIZE soft-miss or fail on directories
issues_faced: PATHGLOB full-path measure/read1 clean without JOIN
Star pattern mixed nested/ dir into inventory
SIZE dir=0 silent; measure wrote nested:0
No language fix this iter — document gaps for MEANINGFUL_ITER
